summary: This document presents the consolidated financial data for Infosys for the third quarter of fiscal 2026. It highlights key metrics such as a 0.6% quarter-over-quarter growth and a 1.7% year-over-year growth in consolidated revenue. The revenue breakdown by business segments shows financial services leading with 28.2%, followed by manufacturing at 16.7%. In terms of client geography, North America accounts for 55.9% of revenues, with Europe at 32.7%. The client data section indicates a total of 1,949 active clients, with significant contributions from the top clients. Overall, the data reflects a stable growth trajectory across various segments and geographies.
